title: Morphogenesis
description: How a blob of identical cells paints itself into a body: reaction and diffusion. Unlocks Turing morphogens.

puzzle.goal: An activator molecule a spreads by diffusion, catalyses its own production (in proportion to a² and inhibited by a second molecule h, with saturation κ at high a), decays at rate μ, and is also produced at a small basal rate. Write the rate of change of the activator concentration.
puzzle.name: Gierer–Meinhardt activator equation (Turing-type reaction–diffusion)
puzzle.ask: Far from the source, where production is negligible, the steady state obeys D∇²a = μa, solved by a = a0·e^(−x√(μ/D)). Find a/a0 at x = @{x} µm for D = @{D} µm²/s and μ = @{μ} /s.
puzzle.method: Add up the processes acting on a: diffusion (Laplacian), autocatalysis divided by inhibition and saturation, linear decay and a constant source.
